proposal.summary: Agregar exclusivamente las cuatro dependencias T3 versionadas y configurar datasource y Flyway según allowlist.
proposal.patch:
diff --git a/apps/time-service/pom.xml b/apps/time-service/pom.xml
--- a/apps/time-service/pom.xml
+++ b/apps/time-service/pom.xml
@@ -39,6 +39,26 @@
       <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test</artifactId>
       <scope>test</scope>
     </dependency>
+    <dependency>
+      <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
+      <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-jdbc</artifactId>
+      <version>4.1.1</version>
+    </dependency>
+    <dependency>
+      <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
+      <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-flyway</artifactId>
+      <version>4.1.1</version>
+    </dependency>
+    <dependency>
+      <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
+      <artifactId>flyway-database-postgresql</artifactId>
+      <version>12.4.0</version>
+    </dependency>
+    <dependency>
+      <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
+      <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
+      <version>42.7.13</version>
+    </dependency>
   </dependencies>
 
   <build>
diff --git a/apps/time-service/src/main/resources/application.properties b/apps/time-service/src/main/resources/application.properties
--- a/apps/time-service/src/main/resources/application.properties
+++ b/apps/time-service/src/main/resources/application.properties
@@ -3,3 +3,9 @@
 # F5 Login (sandbox): usuario por defecto. Solo desarrollo; ver AUTH_SPEC.md y .env.example.
 app.auth.default-username=${APP_AUTH_DEFAULT_USERNAME:demo}
 app.auth.default-password-bcrypt=${APP_AUTH_DEFAULT_PASSWORD_BCRYPT:$2a$10$CO5.OM.rZMc1GUEY68j5BuwHRON65SQb7B63Qvnk8dadapQZ872HW}
+
+spring.datasource.url=${DB_URL:jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:5432/pilot}
+spring.datasource.username=${DB_USERNAME}
+spring.datasource.password=${DB_PASSWORD}
+spring.flyway.enabled=true
+spring.flyway.locations=classpath:db/migration
